canvas.ui_positions: UI 元素（HUD、台词气泡、工具箱、手机、老钱按钮、工具在格子里的位置）以 design/ui/hifi/ui-spec.md 为准，本文件只管美术图层。

normal.note: cup rim centred on the drain at the water surface; the cup must stay inside normal_water_ellipse (rx 34)

full.note: full water is nearer the camera, so the surface contact sits a little higher; cup stays inside opening_ellipse

bowl_geometry_v2.notes: The opening geometry did NOT change from batch 1 (toilet_bowl / tank / lid unchanged); what changed is the water shape and the drain point. Hit-test the bowl with opening_polygon; place the plunger cup at plunger_cup_anchor for the current state.

changelog: v2 (Wen 14:21 反馈): 统一俯视透视；积水按碗型重画（normal/full 都和 toilet_bowl 同尺寸同锚点，s=1 不要缩放）；新增 clog_paper_deep；桶、置物台、洗衣板重画并改坐标；碗口/排水口/皮搋子落点见 canvas.bowl_geometry_v2。

layer_order: (ui_toolbox_dividers only if the body skin has an empty interior)

layers.name: bg_bathroom_base
layers.notes: v2 (统一俯视): one camera, steep top-down ~65°, same as the toilet. Floor tile grid converges gently to the back wall; wall/floor junction ≈ y 280; door (left, x 0–78) seen from above with its top edge; washing machine (right, x 314–390, y 148–385) shows its top lid + foreshortened front. Slippers baked in at lower left (x 0–98, y 448–563). No toilet, bucket, shelf, washboard, tray, phone, ads, portraits or coins. Top 0–44 clear for the capsule menu.

layers.name: toilet_tank
layers.notes: Tank against the back wall. Draw under the lid and flush button. The tank top is blank so the flush-button sprite can be overlaid at (195, 240).

layers.name: toilet_flushbtn_idle
layers.notes: Idle flush button. Hit area should be at least 44x44 even if the art is smaller.

layers.name: toilet_flushbtn_pressed
layers.notes: Pressed state of the flush button, same anchor as idle.

layers.name: toilet_lid_up
layers.notes: Lid raised, leaning on the tank. Draw above the tank, under the 王阿姨 seat cover when that layer is on.

layers.name: toilet_bowl
layers.notes: Bowl, lowered seat ring and pedestal. The inner opening is transparent so water / clogs / the waterline show through. Opening sits at about y=390-578, centered at x=195.

layers.name: toilet_bowl_inner
layers.notes: v2: painted porcelain basin with real depth (far wall shaded, near slope bright, drain throat) PLUS the standing water that always sits in the trap, a soft wet sheen just above it. Same pixel size / anchor as toilet_bowl, opaque only inside the bowl opening. Draw right above toilet_bowl. Because the trap water is painted here, the bowl never looks dry even if no water layer is drawn.

layers.name: water_surface_full
layers.notes: v2 FULL water: same size / anchor as toilet_bowl. Fills the whole opening to the inner rim (darker, ripples, drain visible through the water) and carries ~10 water beads on the seat ring just outside the opening. Draw at s=1. To animate level change, cross-fade full over normal by alpha instead of scaling.

layers.name: water_surface_normal
layers.notes: v2 NORMAL water: same size / anchor as toilet_bowl (draw at s=1, x 195.8 y 507.8 — do NOT scale or shift any more; the old .55+.6*l scaling would show a double edge). Water-only alpha, painted against this exact bowl, so it follows the basin and meets the porcelain with a meniscus. Water ellipse ≈ centre (194.3, 519), rx 34, ry 34 (1x). Matches the water painted in toilet_bowl_inner pixel-for-pixel, so slosh offsets of ±2px are fine.

layers.name: water_ripple_ring
layers.notes: v2: soft broken concentric highlight arcs, centred on the bowl opening. Pulse scale 0.95–1.05 stays inside the opening. Full state only, alpha 0.6–0.9.

layers.name: water_drop
layers.notes: Single droplet particle. Spawn near the rim for full-water overflow and for splash bursts. Anchor is the drop center.

layers.name: water_splash
layers.notes: Short splash burst for pressing a full bowl. Place at the inner rim / water surface.

layers.name: water_waterline_mark
layers.notes: v2: faint beige-grey stain ring above the normal waterline (alpha only), same size / anchor as toilet_bowl. Draw under water_surface_normal in the normal state; hide in the full state.

layers.name: clog_paper
layers.notes: v2: soggy paper wad lodged in the drain, partially submerged (top folds dry with outline, lower sheets seen through water, blue-tinted). Use in the NORMAL water state at (196.2, 518). Alpha by hp as before.

layers.name: clog_paper_deep
layers.notes: v2: same paper wad as seen deep under FULL water (tinted, softened, refracted). Use instead of clog_paper while water is full; same anchor so swapping states does not jump.

layers.name: clog_duck
layers.notes: Yellow rubber duck (order 3, after it is identified / pulled). Do not show in the character portrait or on 李姐. v2: moved down to y 512 so the duck sits in the drain of the new basin.

layers.name: clog_duck_silhouette
layers.notes: Underwater silhouette of the same duck pose. Use while the duck is still hidden in the bowl; the headlamp upgrade can tint / brighten this layer. v2: moved down to y 512 so the duck sits in the drain of the new basin.

layers.name: scene_bucket_empty
layers.notes: v2: red bucket, empty, seen from the same steep top-down camera: near-circular opening, inside and bottom visible, only a short sliver of the side; soft floor shadow baked in (the base touches the floor ≈4px above the sprite bottom). Sits right of the bowl, above the 老钱 button (button top 560). Empty and water versions are pixel-aligned; swap freely.

layers.name: scene_bucket_water
layers.notes: v2: red bucket, about two-thirds full of water, seen from the same steep top-down camera: near-circular opening, inside and bottom visible, only a short sliver of the side; soft floor shadow baked in (the base touches the floor ≈4px above the sprite bottom). Sits right of the bowl, above the 老钱 button (button top 560). Empty and water versions are pixel-aligned; swap freely.

layers.name: home_wang_seatcover
layers.notes: 王阿姨 home layer: pink-and-cream crochet cover, sits on the raised lid.

layers.name: home_wang_windowsill
layers.notes: v2 王阿姨 home layer: wall ledge above the toilet tank (right half), seen from above: top surface visible, pothos pot rim + soil, soap dish, 花露水 bottle cap. x 205–305, y 154–215, clear of the HUD right column (ends y 152) and of the tank top / flush button. The speech bubble / hint (left 16, top 160, max width 240) may briefly cover its left part; nothing on it is interactive.

layers.name: home_wang_washboard
layers.notes: v2 王阿姨 home layer: wooden washboard leaning against the washing machine's front-left, seen from above (top end nearest, ribbed face foreshortened), soft floor shadow baked in. Draw before the tank / lid.

screens_fx_v1._note: 首页、过场、引导动效素材（美术 v1）。只记文件、尺寸、锚点和动画说明；位置以 ui-spec.md v1.2 为准。背景按 390×780 铺满（与 bg_bathroom_base 同规格），无烘焙 UI 文字。jpg 为同图压缩版（约 1/5 体积），小游戏包体用 jpg 即可。

screens.notes: 首页。县城小区巷子黄昏，主角扛皮搋子提工具箱走来。右上 0–44 为天空，胶囊区干净；logo 放上方天空区（建议中心 x195 y175）；开工按钮区 y540–640 压在主角小腿/脚上，主角头和工具箱都在按钮区以上；y650 小字和 y686 ⚙ 下面是素净地面（底部已轻微压暗利于文字）。
到客户家门口：老楼楼道，绿墙裙、电表箱、扶手楼梯。墙上的「疏通管道 1XX-XXXX-XXXX」小广告是唯一允许出现的环境字（假号码）。中部偏上墙面较空，可叠客户名/地点小字。
workday_beats.morning：家里早饭桌（粥、包子、咸菜、鸡蛋、豆浆），门边凳子上放着工具箱和暖水瓶，窗外县城晨光。上方 40% 是暖色晨雾，留给「第 N 天」等代码文字。
workday_beats.commute：主角骑电动车穿过县城街道，后座绑着工具箱和皮搋子，路边有小吃摊（大壮的摊可对应）。上方 35% 是天空。店招均为空白色块，无字。
workday_beats.evening：晚上回家，桌上扣着盘子留的饭、电饭锅保温灯亮着，门边放下的工具箱和皮搋子、换下的球鞋。窗外夜空可叠文字。对应妈妈「锅里给你留了饭」。
G2 开锁单：赵姐家门口正面。门上有福字（门板 1x 约 x103–313、y112–632；福字中心约 x207 y253），左侧鞋柜和绿植，门垫。门上原来的把手已抹掉，锁具全部由代码叠画：建议锁体放在门板把手侧，中心约 x130 y388（1x），不要放在门正中。g2.js 里代码画的门和福字在用这张图时应关掉。

ui.notes: 游戏 logo「重生之我在 / 澳洲修马桶」，思源黑体 Bold 重绘描边+手绘抖动，透明底。不要用代码再叠标题字。
主按钮皮肤，ui-spec 主按钮：高 56、金色渐变、2px 暖棕描边、圆角 16、底部内阴影。9 宫格拉伸到任意宽（最小宽 80），高固定 56。按钮文字由代码写（T2 Bold #5A4030）。外投影由代码画。
按下态，同尺寸同切片；按下时整体下移 2px（ui-spec）。
点击引导的手，奶油白 #FFF3DA + 约 2px（1x）暖棕描边，指尖朝左上。pivot=指尖。放在按钮右下，指尖对准按钮边缘。
点下去的那一帧：绕指尖缩到 0.92 并整体下移 4px（1x），与 ui_guide_hand 同画布同位置绘制即可，不用再加 transform。节奏：1.2 s 一循环，在圆放大开始时切到 tap 帧约 0.15 s。也可只用 ui_guide_hand 按 ui-spec 代码做下压+缩放。
双线圆：奶油白粗线（1x 4px）+ 两侧各 2px 暖棕描边，线宽带轻微手绘起伏，无虚线。冲水引导直接用 64（放大到 1.4 并淡出；外圈 50%）。落点（146×122）和节奏目标圈（120×72）可拉伸使用，椭圆越扁上下线越细，觉得不匀可改用代码画同样的三层线。
同上，中线改为绿色 #9BE08F，用于落点进入范围/节奏判定窗口内。
同上，中线金色 #FFD45E，用于节奏引导的收缩圈（1.4→1.0）。
四角星，奶油白+暖棕描边，ui-spec 里的 ui_sparkle@2x（=ui_sparkle_32）。落点 ok 时闪 3 颗：放大 0→1→0 约 0.4 s，错开 0.1 s，可旋转 ±15°。
小号星星，和 32 混用让三颗大小不一。
